title: 摩根资管Marcel：美债收益率飙升，是配置机会还是周期压力？
speaker: Marcel LaChalle

segments.en: Let's bring in Marcel LaChalle here and set with us global market strategies at JP Morgan asset management. You guys have been advocating very nice to see you by the way. Good morning.
segments.zh: 让我们请出摩根资管的全球市场策略师Marcel LaChalle。顺便说一句，很高兴见到你。早上好。

segments.en: Good morning. Advocating to have a closer look at fixed income. Yes, indeed. With Treasury, you're surpassing like 10 years and also 30 years surpassing 5.2 and 5.5%. We think it's becoming more attractive again.
segments.zh: 早上好。我们主张更关注固定收益。确实如此。10年期和30年期国债收益率分别突破5.2%和5.5%。我们认为它再次变得有吸引力。

segments.en: And indeed, there have been various reasons triggering all these with the fiscal sustainability concerns, inflation issues, and also fact credibility. As such, these are all long-term issues.
segments.zh: 确实，触发这一切的原因多种多样，包括财政可持续性担忧、通胀问题以及信誉因素。因此，这些都是长期性问题。

segments.en: So we're advocating a closer look into probably a shorter and treasuries yields and also investment grade corporate bonds. And because we see how the economic momentum remains quite robust.
segments.zh: 所以我们主张更关注短端国债收益率以及投资级公司债。因为我们看到经济动能仍然相当强劲。

segments.en: That should actually support it for the default rate for high yield to also become, say, relatively low and pressed to be quite tight. Is this just a sense that we're just heading back to normal?
segments.zh: 这实际上应该会支撑高收益债的违约率保持在相对低位，并使其利差维持较窄。这难道只是我们正在回归常态的感觉吗？

segments.en: I mean, gone are the days that we used to see 0% rates post-COVID, the like. But I think is it just that then actually what you've been saying, that this is not really economic distress that we're seeing.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，后疫情时代那种0%利率的日子已经一去不复返了。但我想，这是否正如你一直所说的，我们看到的并不是真正的经济困境。

segments.en: The law and is more with regards to fiscal sustainability. And it's actually global phenomenon too. It's not just US we see in UK and Europe, etc.
segments.zh: 更多是与财政可持续性有关。而且这实际上是一个全球现象。不仅仅是在美国，我们在英国和欧洲等地也看到了。
